let reads = 0;
const values = [0, 2];
Object.defineProperty(values, "0", { get() { return ++reads; }, configurable: true });
console.log(values.map(x => x), reads);
console.log(values.filter(x => x > 0), reads);
console.dir(values, { getters: true });
console.dir(values, { getters: "get" });
console.log(reads);
Object.freeze(values);
console.log(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(values, "0")!.configurable);
try { Object.defineProperty(values, "0", { value: 42 }); } catch (e: any) { console.log(e.message); }
const protectedLength = [1];
Object.defineProperty(protectedLength, "length", { writable: false });
try { Object.defineProperty(protectedLength, "1", { value: 2 }); } catch (e: any) { console.log(e.message); }
try { Object.defineProperty(protectedLength, "2", { get() { return 3; } }); } catch (e: any) { console.log(e.message); }
console.log(protectedLength);
const sealed = [0];
Object.defineProperty(sealed, "0", { get() { return 1; }, configurable: true });
Object.seal(sealed);
console.log(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(sealed, "0")!.configurable);
try { Object.defineProperty(sealed, "0", { get() { return 2; } }); } catch (e: any) { console.log(e.message); }
function args(a: number, ...rest: number[]) {
  a = 5;
  rest.push(9);
  console.log(arguments, rest);
}
args(1, 2, 3);
